description: Implement long-text chunk synthesis, pauses, and fades
notes: Connected browser frontend chunking to sequential core/decoder synthesis using seed+chunk-index noise, upstream punctuation pauses, and 5ms fades. Chromium long prompt passes: 3 chunks, 655 total IDs, 1,674 frames, 439,104 finite 24 kHz samples, valid WAV.
